ops.sql: SELECT Package_ID, Name, Parent_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1155)
SELECT Object_ID, Name, Object_Type, Stereotype, ParentID, Package_ID, Note FROM t_object WHERE Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1155))

SELECT t.Object_ID, t.Property, t.Value FROM t_objectproperties t WHERE t.Property = '505-1 Operation Link' AND t.Object_ID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1155)))
SELECT Diagram_ID, Name, Diagram_Type, ParentID, Package_ID, StyleEx FROM t_diagram WHERE Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1155))

SELECT Connector_ID, Connector_Type, SubType, Stereotype, Start_Object_ID, End_Object_ID, SourceIsAggregate, DestIsAggregate FROM t_connector WHERE Start_Object_ID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1155)))

SELECT Diagram_ID, Object_ID, RectLeft, RectTop, RectRight, RectBottom FROM t_diagramobjects WHERE Diagram_ID IN (SELECT Diagram_ID FROM t_diagram WHERE Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1155)))
